Thought I'd weigh in here since I post a lot. I generally post headlines exactly as they appear -- to avoid accusations of sensationalizing. It occurs anyway. When I do change a title, it is generally to convey info that was presumed in the original title, for instance the state or town in which something occurred to make the headline sensible to the reader.

I do post some link bait -- why? Often as an illustration of how things are being portrayed by the MSM. That is, the news isn't what is in the article, but the way the media chooses to present it. Whether or not we 'like' the way the media portrays things, they often do it with profound bias. It is important to understand and recognize it for what it is.

That said, there are posts and posters that are beyond the bounds. As Oscar Wilde once said, "I may not agree with you, but I will defend to the death your right to make an ass of yourself." Of course none of us have an obligation to listen to screed. A far better solution to the problem would be the ability to ignore users or sources you prefer not to see. Amalek is free to post all she wants though I don't want to see it. She is not censored but I don't have read a word of it.

Finally, I post much more than I ever did at the other site, not for karma or points, but because I like VOAT. It is a far more civil here despite the 'safe spaces' there. VOAT has a wonderful give and take -- even amongst people who fundamentally disagree. The one thing that is lacking is the depth and breadth of content. Rather than bitching about it, like @rectifryer, or moving on I decided to do something about it. I began posting interesting content whenever I came across it. I would prefer to say I saw it here first. The goal is to foster discussion and debate while helping VOAT provide the rich content we've all come to expect.

Though the amount and quality of content is improving, VOAT still has a long way to go. How often do you see posts on the front page that have been there for more than a day? It's even worse in some of the subverses where 'new' posts can be weeks old. Please help make VOAT better -- post interesting things you come across to help build a thriving community here on VOAT.

Thanks,
